**Truly free + ad-free** (closest to “no catch”) is rare. Most Toca clones are free download but lock rooms behind IAP.

### Closest to “just play”
| App | Why | Catch |
|-----|-----|--------|
| **[Little Worlds: Stickers](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/little-worlds-stickers/id6759228345)** | Drag stickers into small scenes (farm, beach, space). No ads, no tracking, no IAP. | Simpler than Toca — sticker scenes, not full dollhouse. |
| **[Tiny Toybox](https://www.tinytoyboxgames.com/)** | Browser 3D worlds + mini-games. No ads, no account, no IAP. | Need internet; parent-with-kid design. |
| **[MindCraft](https://github.com/kinncj/MindCraft)** | Browser creative block building. No ads, no accounts, no monsters. | More Minecraft creative than Toca life-play. |
| **[Towniz World](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/towniz-world-avatar-life/id6752649467)** | My Town Games. Open town, decorate, dress-up. Claims no ads; locations free. | Newest — double-check IAP/social features before kid uses alone. |

### Also free + usually ad-free (not full Toca clones)
- **PBS Kids Games** (site/app) — shorts + play, no commercial ads
- **ScratchJr** — free creative build/play (coding-ish, not dollhouse)

### Skip if you want *both* free and ad-free forever
**Nimi Games**, many **Cocobi / My Town** titles, **Toca** itself — often ad-free *or* free core, then subscription/packs. Not both long-term.

**Bottom line:** For zero ads + zero pay, start **Little Worlds** (phone) or **Tiny Toybox** (browser). For bigger Toca-style town, try **Towniz** and verify store listing for IAP before handing to kid.

**Android-only.** Hard truth: Play Store almost never gives full Toca-size world with *zero* ads *and* zero IAP. Closest matches below.

### Best Toca-style (free + no ads)
| App | Play Store | Notes |
|-----|------------|--------|
| **[Towniz](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mytowngames.towniz)** | My Town Games | Closest. Dress-up, houses, whole town open free. Claims **no ads**. Check listing for optional IAP (cosmetics), not locked rooms. |
| **[Terra World](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.imayi.terraworld)** | Yateland | Open scenes (school, park, houses). **No third-party ads**, offline. Core free; extra scenes/items = IAP. |

### Free + no ads, but not full dollhouse
- **[ScratchJr](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.scratchjr.android)** — free creative build/play, no ads. Coding-ish, not Toca life-play.
- **Chrome on Android** — [Tiny Toybox](https://www.tinytoyboxgames.com/) (no ads, no account). Browser, not install.

### Skip for your rules
- **Lila’s World** — ads + IAP  
- **Bibi World / Pok Pok** — no ads, but subscription after free trial  
- **Little Worlds Stickers** — iOS only  

**Start here:** install **Towniz**, then **Terra World** if you want a second offline option. Before kid plays alone: open Play Store page → check “Contains ads” and “In-app purchases.”
